items.title: A dualizing complex normalised relative to a covering is unique up to unique isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-dualizing, for X of finite type over S and a finite open covering U of X by separated schemes, the lemma asserts that a dualizing complex normalised relative to omega_S and U, if it exists, is unique up to unique isomorphism (statement lines 5316-5345). Given two such complexes (K, alpha_i) and (K', alpha'_i), the proof considers L = RSheafHom_{O_X}(K, K'), which by Lemma labelled lemma-dualizing-unique-schemes and its proof is an invertible object of D(O_X) (proof lines 5347-5354). Using the local trivialisations, the proof produces an isomorphism alpha_i^t otimes alpha'_i from L|_{U_i} to RSheafHom(O_{omega_i^bullet}, O_{omega_i^bullet}) = O_{U_i}[0], which already forces L = H^0(L)[0]; moreover H^0(L) is an invertible sheaf trivialised on the opens U_i (proof lines 5356-5364). Finally the compatibility condition, that both alpha_j alpha_i^{-1} and alpha'_j (alpha'_i)^{-1} induce the same transition map phi_{ij}, shows that the transition maps of H^0(L) are the identity, so H^0(L) = O_X and the isomorphism is unique (proof lines 5366-5370). Turning the sheaf of Homs into an invertible sheaf with prescribed trivialisations, and reading uniqueness off the cocycle condition, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
